ars_backports.gauntlet.invalid: Invalid spell. Gauntlets accept Effects and Augments only.
ars_backports.fishing_rod.invalid: Invalid Spell. Enchanter's Fishing Rod accept Effects and Augments only.
ars_backports.glyph_desc.glyph_pantomime: Applies spells to the nearest block in your line of sight. Dampen will reduce the distance, Amplify will increase it. Sensitive will highlight the selected block.
ars_backports.glyph_desc.glyph_bubble: Captures mobs and entities it touches, causing them to float upwards. If the bubble has been alive for at least one tick, damaging the entity trapped in the bubble will cause it to pop, dealing bonus damage to the entity inside. Extend time and amplify can be used to increase the duration and damage of the bubble.
